name: needs-you-clock-d
title: Needs you · the snooze clock
note: Every card ends its top line with the clock; the open panel has it beside ×.

name: snooze-open-d
title: Snooze · opened from a card
note: The popover hangs from the clock it came from.

name: snooze-no-venue-d
title: Snooze · an item with no venue
note: Artist, price check, price batch and bug items: snooze only, no Not useful.

name: snooze-until-a-date-d
title: Snooze · until a date
note: The menu turns into a month picker in place. Back at 8 AM MT on that day.

name: not-useful-d
title: Not useful · reason
note: Turns one kind of warning off for one venue. A reason is picked, a note is optional.

name: answered-d
title: Answered rows · notifying and snoozed
note: A notifying answer has no Undo and says who was told; a snooze has Undo. The badge and filter counts drop at once.

name: item-menu-m
title: Phone · the item ⋯
note: On the phone the clock lives in the item page’s ⋯, as a sheet.

name: answered-m
title: Phone · answered rows
note: The same two rows, on the phone list.

name: warnings-off-overview-d
title: Venue Overview · turned-off warnings
note: The way back on: the venue’s In Needs you card lists each warning kind you turned off.

name: all-clear-d
title: Needs you · all clear, desktop
note: No badge at zero. Snoozed counts every snoozed item, with the next one back.

name: filter-empty-d
title: Needs you · a filter with nothing in it
note: One line and Show all; not the all-clear.

name: couldnt-load-m
title: Needs you · couldn’t load, phone
note: The badge hides when its count can’t load.

name: loading-d
title: Needs you · loading, desktop
note: The final shape: filter pills, stacked cards, the panel.

name: fan-suggest-a-venue-m
title: Send feedback · Suggest a venue
note: Picking Suggest a venue swaps the box for Venue name, Website (optional) and Anything else. No screenshot option for this kind.

name: fan-suggest-a-venue-empty-m
title: Suggest a venue · empty fields
note: Placeholders. Send stays off until there is a venue name.

name: fan-suggest-a-venue-d
title: Suggest a venue · desktop modal
note: The same body in a centered modal over the page.

name: fan-feedback-sent-m
title: Send feedback · sent
note: One sent state for every kind.

name: admin-suggestion-d
title: Admin · a venue suggestion with a website
note: Name and website come from the form; robots.txt is checked against the website.

name: admin-suggestion-no-website-d
title: Admin · a suggestion with no website
note: No URL, no robots check yet: it runs when you set the venue up.

name: admin-suggestion-m
title: Admin · a venue suggestion, phone
note: Full screen (decision 1), answers pinned.

name: venues-select-d
title: Venues · Select
note: Bulk select is for Re-crawl and Pause only. Hide, Delete and Take down stay one venue at a time.

name: venue-menu-states
title: Venue ⋯ menu · every state
note: Paused, auto-paused or blocked, hidden, and flagship. Take down is the last line on every one (decision 21).

name: delete-refused
title: Venue ⋯ · Delete refused
note: The line is disabled and says why. No dialog.

name: take-down-d
title: Take down · asks first
note: Deletes the venue, its shows and their prices for good.

name: pause-panel-d
title: Pause crawling · desktop
note: A side panel (rule 4), the same fields as the phone sheet. Other takes a note; Pick a date opens the picker in place.

name: hide-other-d
title: Hide from site · Other
note: Other takes a note. Asked us to stop moves to Take down.

name: re-crawl-states
title: Re-crawl · queued, running, unavailable
note: Disabled while paused or disallowed, with the reason beside the chips.

name: last-14-runs-legend
title: Last 14 runs · legend
note: Every bar kind, including Failed, Partial and Paused.

name: venue-overview-m
title: Venue Overview · phone, every card
note: The caption wins: the phone stacks every desktop card.

name: drafts-in-list-d
title: Venues · drafts
note: A Drafts filter, and the waiting draft row with its two answers.

name: details-d
title: Venue Details · every field
note: Adds Neighborhood, Map pin, Price page, Website, Contact email, and a Look card for the icon and hero setting.

name: details-m
title: Venue Details · phone
note: The same cards, stacked.

name: details-no-icon
title: Details · Look, before an icon
note: Where Skip leads after going live.

name: no-reply-d
title: Needs you · Ask the venue, no reply
note: A VENUE item 14 days after asking, with its panel and answers.

name: venue-notice-d
title: Needs you · a venue notice
note: Several shows at one venue vanishing in one run is one card. Look at each splits it into show cards.

name: kind-labels
title: Needs you · the kind labels
note: The canonical set and tones. FLAG is signal.

name: more-interim-m
title: Admin More · interim Invite codes row
note: Phone twin of addendum 2 item 8: from 0a until 5b.

name: runs-filters-m
title: Crawl runs · phone filters
note: Rule 6: the filters become a segmented control.

name: run-result-chips
title: Crawl runs · result chips
note: One chip per venue outcome.

name: crawl-all-m
title: Crawl all · phone sheet
note: Says how many are skipped, and why.

name: crawl-all-done-d
title: Crawl all · finished banner
note: The running banner becomes a summary you close.

name: runs-filter-empty-d
title: Crawl runs · a filter with nothing in it

name: loading-runs-d
title: Crawl runs · loading
note: The final table shape (rule 9).

name: load-more

name: panel-answer-failed

note: Rule 10, inside the panel.

name: postponed-d

note: Optional new date.

name: venue-blocked-before-3c
title: Venue blocked · before Ask the venue ships

name: venue-failing-m
title: Phone item · a venue
note: The footer pattern for every kind: the main answer full width, the rest below.

name: price-batch-d

name: add-a-show-lineup-d

note: The lineup uses the edit page’s chips: first is the headliner.

name: person-menu-d
